summary: Example declaring AAPTokenField hidden (ui:widget: hidden and ui:backstage review show: false) and passing parameters.token to rhaap:launch-job-template. Missing or invalid tokens raise 'Authorization token not provided'; errors are surfaced without stack traces, and later steps stop after an auth failure.
questions: How do I hide the AAP token from the self-service form and review?
What does 'Authorization token not provided' mean in a self-service template?
What happens to later steps when a rhaap action fails to authenticate?

answer_card.title: Hidden AAPTokenField
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
parameters:
  - title: Authentication
    properties:
      token:
        title: AAP Authentication Token
        type: string
        ui:field: AAPTokenField
        ui:widget: hidden
        ui:backstage:
          review:
            show: false
steps:
  - id: launch-job
    action: rhaap:launch-job-template
    input:
      token: ${{ parameters.token }}
```
A missing or invalid token fails with `Authorization token not provided`.
